summary_rationale: RNIT has a credible, newly assembled software and AI operation with audited FY2025–FY2026 revenue and profit, named government deployments and a coherent suite across identity, education workflows, conversational AI and enterprise software. This is evidence of a functioning business, not yet a durable software compounder: the audited segment combines products and services, while recurring revenue, product margins, customer concentration and renewal metrics are not disclosed. FY2026 CFO was positive, but asset purchases exceeded it and the cash-flow reconciliation included borrowing and tax-liability inflows while receivables and other current assets absorbed cash. H1 FY2027 then reported positive PAT with negative CFO and materially higher receivables. Goodwill and intangibles form a large part of assets, consultancy costs exceed employee costs, and related-party funding has been used. The short post-restructuring record and interim cash weakness justify a conditional assessment rather than a failure verdict. Monitor collections, ageing, customer acceptance, product reuse, recurring revenue, impairment and balance-sheet funding needs.
